tips.title: 9 text ask(s) on gpt-4o, o3 would cost 0.203313-0.81325 Wh less on gpt-4o-mini (86% of their energy)

examples: How do I square every number in a Python list?
And only keep the even ones?
Rewrite this to sound friendlier: 'Send me the report by Friday.'

tips.how_to_fix: Send short asks like those 9 to gpt-4o-mini instead of gpt-4o, o3; your history shows it keeps the same answers at 86% less energy.

tips.title: 4 duplicate ask(s) across 2 repeated question(s) cost 0.12945-0.5178 Wh

examples: How do I center a div in CSS on my ZEBRAQUARTZ page?
Rewrite this to sound friendlier: 'Send me the report by Friday.'

tips.how_to_fix: Ask each of those 2 question(s) once and reuse the answer; the 4 re-typed ask(s) bought nothing new.

tips.title: 1 regenerated response(s) wasted 0.006825-0.0273 Wh; 1 of them re-asked a question you had already asked

examples: Rewrite this to sound friendlier: 'Send me the report by Friday.'

tips.how_to_fix: Put length, tone and format in the first prompt so its answer is usable: 1 of 12 responses here were regenerations.
